newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Montreal launches 10-yr 6 bln esc Navigator.
newsitem.headline: Montreal launches 10-yr 6 bln esc Navigator.

text.p: The Canadian city of Montreal is launching a 10-year six billion escudo Navigator bond, indexed to six-month Lisbor plus 40 basis points, up to a cap of nine percent, said the leaders, Deutsche Bank de Investimento (DBI) and Banco Mello de Investimentos (BMI).
COUPON: Six-month Lisbor plus 40 bp, subject to cap of nine
INTEREST PAYMENTS: Every six months on June 20 and December 20
each year, with the first coupon on December 20 1997
REIMBURSEMENT: At par, on the date of the 20th coupon payment
LISTING: To be sought on Luxembourg bourse
NATIONAL PAYING AGENT: Deutsche Bank de Investimento, SA
